item.title: Distortion Risk Measures & Stochastic Dominance
item.description:
My current work focuses on distortion risk measures, stochastic dominance, and related quantile representations.

I am especially interested in endpoint conditions and extensions towards fractional stochastic dominance, with a broader interest in how mathematical risk theory connects to statistical learning and quantitative research.
